text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"—The result at the Shuka Sho was great. 
(I reckon you saw it on TV)... But still, 
I wasn't able to pull off that 'dazzling 
run.'"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, the fans called me a 'City 
Girl.' ...I should be happy about that, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"...Was I ever really shining...? I 
honestly don't know anymore. What am I... 
even running for...?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"...This letter somehow turned into 
somethin' that might make 'em worry. I 
guess I won't send it..."
